slides.title: Asset Security Dashboard
say: Hi, I’m Ammaar, and this is my Cyber Ready Clinic capstone.
I built a dashboard that helps small organizations keep track of their devices and basic security information.

slides.title: Why I decided to build this
say: During Discover 5 in Cyber Ready Clinic, I learned how important it is to know what devices an organization has and how they’re protected.
If that information is missing or out of date, it’s harder to tell what needs attention.

slides.title: What my dashboard does
say: My dashboard puts device information in one place.
You can record the status of updates, security software, and backups.
Based on those records, it highlights gaps and suggests what to check next.

slides.title: Here’s an example
say: This laptop’s record shows overdue updates, so the dashboard flags it.
Once someone confirms the updates are installed, they update the record and the recorded finding clears.

slides.title: What I took away from this
say: CRC taught me why it matters to know what devices you have. Building this also taught me to keep missing information visible.
The dashboard organizes what people record. It doesn’t scan devices or verify their security.
